tagline_zh: 还在为GLSL报错抓瞎？这套skill把ShaderMaterial、uniforms和顶点/片元逻辑拆成可调参数。
tagline_en: Tired of GLSL errors with no clue? This skill turns ShaderMaterial, uniforms, and vertex/fragment logic into.
